comment: The module declares two outputs in its OutputId enum but adds no jack for either, so neither can be reached and neither gets a line. None of the five inputs is given a name with configInput, so hovering them shows nothing. The transpose and rest CVs are scaled so that one volt covers the whole control (ProteusX.cpp:448-449), not the ten volts used elsewhere in the plugin. At ProteusX.cpp:443-445 the save, load and clear buttons of a slot are all passed through the same SchmittTrigger, buttonTrigs[button], one after another in the same sample, so the three share one piece of edge-detection state; that is worth testing in the rack before relying on rapid presses.
